title: Commodity Manager at Inventec Data Center Solutions Believes Unimicron Will Retain AI ABF Business Despite Rising Competition
expert: Commodity manager at a large Taiwan AI data-center ODM (PCB/PCBA sourcing since 2018); sees Unimicron lead times, yields and capacity reservations on hyperscaler projects
verdict: A large AI-server ODM gets Unimicron AI ABF boards in 16–20 weeks, stable y/y, and sees only 1%–3% pricing room next year, while its Unimicron volumes grow more than 25% a year.

ABF supply/demand gap: 🔴 AI ABF lead time 16–20 weeks, stable y/y (first-hand) vs TrendForce and Citi at 48–56 weeks (SB #61055, SB #65968): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (ABF oligopoly) ↓
🟢 ODM's Unimicron ABF volume growing more than 25% a year (estimate); fits Unimicron's +30-40% ABF output plan for 2027 (SB #54455). → Tenet 1 (ABF oligopoly) ↑
ASP trajectory: 🔴 Pricing room only 1%–3% next year (estimate) vs Edgewater's +10–15% on LTSA customers (SB #65932) and Citi's 10–15% in 4Q (SB #65968): conflicting. → Tenet 2 (ASP inflation) ↓

🟡 Capacity reserved on forecasts, paid after delivery (first-hand), no prepayment at this ODM vs >NT\$100bn prepaid by Intel, NVIDIA and AMD (SB #62027): different customer tier. → Tenet 2 (ASP inflation) →
NVDA/ASIC share retention: 🔴 SEMCO could dilute share about 3 points on new NVIDIA platforms (estimate); NVIDIA named SEMCO alongside Unimicron in its 2.5x capacity plan (SB #61556): consistent. → Tenet 1 (ABF oligopoly) ↓
🟢 Yield 1%–3 points above Victory Giant on HDI, ASIC share +~1 point per generation (estimates). → Tenet 1 (ABF oligopoly) ↑

characterization_changed: Positive: stable 16–20 week lead times and only 1%–3% pricing room cut against the tightness and ASP case, offsetting >25% volume growth.
changes: Lead times: 16–20 weeks and stable y/y vs TrendForce 48–56 weeks from ~12 previously (SB #61055) and Citi 48–56 weeks (SB #65968): conflicting.
Pricing: 1%–3% room next year vs Edgewater +10–15% on LTSA customers (SB #65932) and Citi 10–15% in 4Q (SB #65968): conflicting.
Prepayment: none at this ODM (payment after delivery) vs Fubon checks that KF Fab 2 reservation fees are fully paid (SB #61148): conflicting, likely a different customer tier.
Share: ~3-point SEMCO dilution on new platforms vs NVIDIA's 2.5x plan with IBIDEN, SEMCO and Unimicron (SB #61556): consistent.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (ABF oligopoly, capacity-gated share): → — >25% volume growth and a 1%–3 point yield lead vs ~3-point SEMCO dilution and stable lead times.
Tenet 2 (cyclical/contractual ASP inflation): ↓ — 1%–3% pricing room next year vs 10–15% in Street checks.
Tenet 4 (GM inflection): ↓ — less price means mix and utilization must carry the margin ramp.
